narration_fil: Binisita ni BHW Salma si Ben sa Marawi. Hindi siya makapunta sa health center sa umaga dahil sa trabaho. “Hindi ko kayang mawala buong araw,” sabi niya. Hindi pa alam ni Salma kung may ibang iskedyul ang staff.
narration_en: BHW Salma visits Ben in Marawi. He cannot go to the health center in the morning because of work. “I cannot lose a whole day,” he says. Salma does not yet know whether staff offer another schedule.

display_fil:
Linawin ang nais na resulta.
Magtanong ng alternatibo.
Mag-alok ng kayang gawin.
Kumpirmahin ang tao at oras.
display_en:
Clarify the desired outcome.
Ask about alternatives.
Offer what you can do.
Confirm the person and time.
narration_fil: Linawin kung anong resulta ang nais ng kausap. Itanong kung may naiisip siyang ibang paraan. Mag-alok lamang ng kayang gawin o kumpirmahin. Sabihin: “Maaari kong itanong ang ibang iskedyul. Gusto po ba ninyo iyon?” Kumpirmahin kung sino ang kikilos at kailan magbabalitaan.
narration_en: Clarify the outcome the person wants. Ask whether they have another approach in mind. Offer only what you can do or confirm. Say, “I can ask about another schedule. Would you like that?” Confirm who will act and when you will update each other.

check.prompt_fil: Hindi pa alam ni Salma ang iskedyul. Ano ang maaari niyang ialok kay Ben?
check.prompt_en: Salma does not know the schedule yet. What can she offer Ben?

options.fil: Itanong sa health center at magbalita sa takdang oras.
options.en: Ask the health center and update him at an agreed time.

options.fil: Mangakong may staff kahit anong oras siya dumating.
options.en: Promise staff will be available whenever he arrives.

options.fil: Ipalagay na hindi interesado si Ben sa serbisyo.
options.en: Assume Ben is not interested in the service.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Ito ay tiyak na gawaing kayang gawin nang hindi nangangako ng appointment. 2: Hindi pa kumpirmado ang availability ng staff. 3: Hadlang sa oras ang sinabi ni Ben, hindi kawalan ng interes.
check.feedback_en: 1: This is a concrete action without promising an appointment. 2: Staff availability has not been confirmed. 3: Ben described a time barrier, not a lack of interest.

narration_fil: Piliin muna ang sagot. Pagkatapos, basahin ang paliwanag para sa bawat pagpipilian.
narration_en: Choose an answer first. Then read why each choice helps or does not help.

display_fil:
Salma: magtatanong sa health center.
Update: bukas, alas-dos.
Hindi pa appointment ang napagkasunduan.
display_en:
Salma will ask the health center.
Update: tomorrow at two.
The agreement is not an appointment yet.
narration_fil: Ben: “Puwede kaya sa hapon?” Salma: “Itatanong ko po sa health center. Tatawagan ko kayo bukas ng alas-dos kung iyon ay ayos.” Ben: “Oo.” Salma: “Wala pa pong kumpirmadong appointment; update muna bukas.” Malinaw kung ano ang napagkasunduan at kung ano ang hindi pa tiyak.
narration_en: Ben: “Could it be in the afternoon?” Salma: “I will ask the health center. I can call you tomorrow at two if that works.” Ben: “Yes.” Salma: “The appointment is not confirmed yet; tomorrow’s call is an update.” The agreement and uncertainty are both clear.

display_fil:
Tumulong sa pakikipag-ugnayan.
Huwag maggarantiya ng iskedyul.
Humingi ng gabay kung walang opsyon.
Agarang panganib: emergency help.
display_en:
Help coordinate.
Do not guarantee a schedule.
Seek guidance when no option fits.
Immediate danger: emergency help.
narration_fil: Tungkulin ng BHW na tumulong sa pakikipag-ugnayan, hindi maggarantiya ng iskedyul o pilitin ang pagsang-ayon. Kapag walang angkop na pagpipilian, humingi ng gabay sa midwife o supervisor. Kung may agarang panganib, unahin ang emergency service; huwag gamitin ang ordinaryong follow-up bilang kapalit ng agarang tulong.
narration_en: The BHW helps coordinate; do not guarantee a schedule or force agreement. If no suitable option is available, ask the midwife or supervisor. If there is immediate danger, prioritize emergency services; routine follow-up must not replace urgent help.

check.feedback_en: 1: No action or update time is assigned. 2: This turns an unconfirmed discussion into an appointment. 3: This has an action, owner and time to confirm with Ben.

display_en:
Action + responsible person + time.
On Monday: practise with the action card.
Follow-up: find out the result.
narration_fil: Isinulat ni Salma: siya ang magtatanong sa health center at tatawag kay Ben bukas ng alas-dos. Inulit ni Ben ang napagkasunduan. Sa Lunes, gamitin ang blangkong action card sa isang pagsasanay kasama ang katrabaho. Salita: follow-up — pagbabalik sa napag-usapan upang alamin ang resulta.
narration_en: Salma writes that she will ask the health center and call Ben tomorrow at two. Ben repeats the agreement. On Monday, use the blank action card in practice with a colleague. Word: follow-up — returning to an agreement to find out the result.
